Runs from original reading timestamp to receipt on farmer phone.
• Hop 1 (10 s): Reading taken to message ready. Node publishes every reading immediately; no batching or threshold logic on device.
• Hop 2 (60 s): Radio wake, network attach, TLS session setup. Cellular LTE-M/NB-IoT/Cat-1 or satellite IP contact.
• Hop 3 (20 s): MQTT publish QoS 1 to PUBACK at IoT Core endpoint in us-east-1. Release from local buffer on PUBACK.
• Hop 4 (10 s): Topic rule execution. Telemetry table write + SQS threshold queue enqueue (ASM-161).
• Hop 5 (20 s): Threshold Lambda execution. Strongly consistent read of telemetry record, query active Federation threshold version, episode deduplication, write alert store, publish to SNS alert topic.
• Hop 6 (30 s): Alert topic to channel provider. SNS fanout to SQS, notification dispatcher Lambda reads PII from personal DB (KMS 'personal'), renders messages, applies SMS coalescing.
• Hop 7 (60 s): Provider to phone. Parallel dispatch via AWS EUM SMS and Amazon SNS Mobile Push (FCM/APNs).
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Totals: Target Sum = 210 s | Retry Margin = 90 s | SLA Limit = 300 s (5 min).

Tie to Point 6 Alert-Delivery SLO (A21, PD-082, PD-134):
• Live Alert SLI: Share of out-of-range readings published live (not from buffer) delivered within 300 seconds of original reading timestamp.
• Trace points: reading_ts, puback_ts, function_start_ts, alert_persisted_ts, sns_ts, send_ts, delivery_receipt_ts.
• Offline Buffer Drain SLI: Drained readings delivered within 24 hours of capture; measured separately from live SLO." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="775" width="690" x="45" y="1980" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2_bg" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f7fafc;strokeColor=#d69e2e;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="820" width="720" x="760" y="1940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2_hdr" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d69e2e;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;spacingLeft=12;" value="2. FEDERATION THRESHOLDS (CONFIGURABLE DATA, NEVER IN CODE)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="720" x="760" y="1940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2_txt" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=11;fontColor=#2d3748;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacing=10;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="Initial Ranges Table from Case Statement (Sec 4.1):
• T-01 [Crop]: pH outside 4.5 - 6.0 (Recommended 4.9 - 5.6) | Unit: pH | Source: Soil analysis (ASM-053).
• T-02 [Crop]: Air moisture outside 40 % - 80 % relative humidity | Source: Crop node.
• T-03 [Crop]: Soil moisture outside 40 % - 80 % | Source: Crop node (ASM-131).
• T-04 [Crop]: Air temperature outside 14 °C - 30 °C (Recommended 17 °C - 23 °C) | Source: Crop node.
• T-05 [Crop]: Soil temperature outside 14 °C - 30 °C (Recommended 17 °C - 23 °C) | Source: Crop node.
• T-06..T-08 [Crop]: NPK (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium) | Pending publication by Federation (ASM-054). Stored without alerts until published.
• T-09 [Drying]: Coffee moisture lot closure near 12 % | Tolerance: 0 (ASM-133) | Notice, not alert (ASM-059).
• T-10 [Drying]: Grain temperature alert above 40 °C | Source: Drying node.

Configuration & Scope Model (Sec 4.2, ASM-138):
• Threshold store: DynamoDB 'thresholds' table in workload account, encrypted with customer-managed key 'records' (ASM-097). PK: rule_key, SK: effective_from.
• Scope resolution: Farm-specific rule (crop#soil_moisture#farm#<farm_id>) overrides Pilot rule (crop#soil_moisture#pilot). NPK is pilot-wide.
• Historical immutability: Version in force at original_timestamp is evaluated, ensuring drained readings evaluate identically to live ones.
• No cache in Lambda: Strongly consistent query on every invocation; updates apply to the immediate next reading.
• Audit trail: CloudTrail data events (write-only) + DynamoDB Streams audit consumer delivering to S3 Object Lock archive (5-year retention, ASM-067)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="775" width="710" x="765" y="1980" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p3_bg" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f7fafc;strokeColor=#dd6b20;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="820" width="720" x="1500" y="1940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p3_hdr" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dd6b20;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;spacingLeft=12;" value="3. EPISODE MODEL, DEDUPLICATION & STORE-AND-FORWARD DRAIN" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="720" x="1500" y="1940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p3_txt" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=11;fontColor=#2d3748;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacing=10;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="Why Deduplicate (Sec 6.1, ASM-135):
• Crop variables stay out of range for hours; drying grain stays hot until turned.
• Without deduplication: 1 alert every 4 hours per crop variable (or every hour in drying); 24 messages per drain.
• Prevents drone pest case explosion under ADR-002: unit of alerting is the episode, not the reading.

Episode State Machine (Sec 6.2, Alert Store, KMS 'records'):
• Open Episode: First out-of-range reading for a key with no open episode executes conditional put. Winner emits notification and persists crop_alert_raised (ADR-002 mode switch); loser attaches.
• Attach Reading: Subsequent out-of-range readings of same key update count, latest value, and extreme value. Zero notifications sent.
• Close Episode: First in-range reading with timestamp later than latest out-of-range reading closes episode (alert_resolved). Push notification sent.
• 24-Hour Reminder: If episode remains open after 24 hours, push reminder sent once per 24 hours (push only, no SMS, ASM-135).
• Drying Lot Closure: Coffee moisture <= 12% emits single drying_closure_notice per lot; marks lot ready to close (sec 6.5).

Store-and-Forward Drain Behavior (Sec 6.4, ASM-074):
• Buffer sizing: Encrypted non-volatile ring buffer holds at least 24 hours of readings (6 crop, 24 drying).
• Drainage order: On reconnection, live reading sent first, then buffered records drain oldest first.
• Delayed alert handling: Receive time > 300 s after original timestamp flagged delayed = true. Farmer sees 'measured at' and 'received at'.
• Single notification per drain: Oldest drained reading opens episode; following readings attach. 1 notification, not 24." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="775" width="710" x="1505" y="1980" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p4_bg" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f7fafc;strokeColor=#4a5568;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="820" width="720" x="2240" y="1940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p4_hdr" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#4a5568;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;spacingLeft=12;" value="4. WHAT THE FARMER SEES & ARCHITECTURAL TRACEABILITY" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="720" x="2240" y="1940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p4_txt" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=11;fontColor=#2d3748;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacing=10;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="Multi-Channel Strategy (Closes PD-085, ASM-136):
• Dual channel: Push + SMS for alert openings and closure notices. Push only for reminders & resolutions.
• SMS: Reaches farmer over cellular connection even without data plan (LTE or later, A10 sec 11).
• Push: Enriches farmer app with full history and charts when phone enters data coverage (town/road).
• SMS Coalescing: First SMS sent immediately; further alerts for same farm within 10 min combined into 1 SMS (ASM-135).

Farmer Perception & Example Messages (Sec 8, Colombia Time America/Bogota):
• SMS, Live: 'Aroma Pacifico: farm El Mirador, soil moisture 34 % (range 40-80 %), measured 14:02. Check the app.'
• SMS, Delayed: 'Aroma Pacifico: farm El Mirador, drying grain 43 C (limit 40 C), measured yesterday 23:10, received 06:15.'
• SMS, Closure: 'Aroma Pacifico: farm El Mirador, drying lot at 12 % moisture. The lot can be closed.'
• Push, Resolution: 'Soil moisture back in range (52 %) at 18:02.'
• Messages carry farm alias only; zero farmer names, cedulas, coordinates, or clickable links.
• Farmer App (3 views): Farm Status Card (active alerts, last heard), Alerts List, History Charts (with recommended bands).

IaC & Box Traceability (Architecture sec 14, Track B):
• Box D08: Reusable Farm Module (field node, sensors, 24h buffer, X.509 cert) -> B08.
• Box D09: Telemetry Ingestion Pattern (IoT Core, topic rules, DynamoDB telemetry table, error SQS) -> B09.
• Box D10: Event-Driven Inference & Function Pattern (Threshold queue, Lambda rules engine, Alert Store, SNS) -> B10.
• Box D06: Identity & KMS Encryption Keys ('telemetry', 'records', 'personal') -> B06." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="775" width="710" x="2245" y="1980" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
• Signal loss: Reading retained in encrypted non-volatile RAM (max 24 h). Evicted readings counted and reported in telemetry_gap event.
• Reconnection: Live reading published first, then buffered records drain oldest first. Evaluated at original_timestamp.
• Delayed flag: Readings with (arrival_time - original_timestamp) > 300 s marked delayed = true. Deduplication guarantees 1 alert per drain.

div.div: 1. 5-MINUTE LATENCY BUDGET & SLO ARCHITECTURE

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 672px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1985px; margin-left: 170px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #2d3748;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#2d3748, #b7bfce); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Latency Budget per Hop (Connectivity sec 8.2, ASM-075):
Runs from original reading timestamp to receipt on farmer phone.
• Hop 1 (10 s): Reading taken to message ready. Node publishes every reading immediately; no batching or threshold logic on device.
• Hop 2 (60 s): Radio wake, network attach, TLS session setup. Cellular LTE-M/NB-IoT/Cat-1 or satellite IP contact.
• Hop 3 (20 s): MQTT publish QoS 1 to PUBACK at IoT Core endpoint in us-east-1. Release from local buffer on PUBACK.
• Hop 4 (10 s): Topic rule execution. Telemetry table write + SQS threshold queue enqueue (ASM-161).
• Hop 5 (20 s): Threshold Lambda execution. Strongly consistent read of telemetry record, query active Federation threshold version, episode deduplication, write alert store, publish to SNS alert topic.
• Hop 6 (30 s): Alert topic to channel provider. SNS fanout to SQS, notification dispatcher Lambda reads PII from personal DB (KMS 'personal'), renders messages, applies SMS coalescing.
• Hop 7 (60 s): Provider to phone. Parallel dispatch via AWS EUM SMS and Amazon SNS Mobile Push (FCM/APNs).
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Totals: Target Sum = 210 s | Retry Margin = 90 s | SLA Limit = 300 s (5 min).
Tie to Point 6 Alert-Delivery SLO (A21, PD-082, PD-134):
• Live Alert SLI: Share of out-of-range readings published live (not from buffer) delivered within 300 seconds of original reading timestamp.
• Trace points: reading_ts, puback_ts, function_start_ts, alert_persisted_ts, sns_ts, send_ts, delivery_receipt_ts.
• Offline Buffer Drain SLI: Drained readings delivered within 24 hours of capture; measured separately from live SLO.

div.div: 2. FEDERATION THRESHOLDS (CONFIGURABLE DATA, NEVER IN CODE)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 692px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1985px; margin-left: 890px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #2d3748;

div.div:
Initial Ranges Table from Case Statement (Sec 4.1):
• T-01 [Crop]: pH outside 4.5 - 6.0 (Recommended 4.9 - 5.6) | Unit: pH | Source: Soil analysis (ASM-053).
• T-02 [Crop]: Air moisture outside 40 % - 80 % relative humidity | Source: Crop node.
• T-03 [Crop]: Soil moisture outside 40 % - 80 % | Source: Crop node (ASM-131).
• T-04 [Crop]: Air temperature outside 14 °C - 30 °C (Recommended 17 °C - 23 °C) | Source: Crop node.
• T-05 [Crop]: Soil temperature outside 14 °C - 30 °C (Recommended 17 °C - 23 °C) | Source: Crop node.
• T-06..T-08 [Crop]: NPK (Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium) | Pending publication by Federation (ASM-054). Stored without alerts until published.
• T-09 [Drying]: Coffee moisture lot closure near 12 % | Tolerance: 0 (ASM-133) | Notice, not alert (ASM-059).
• T-10 [Drying]: Grain temperature alert above 40 °C | Source: Drying node.
Configuration & Scope Model (Sec 4.2, ASM-138):
• Threshold store: DynamoDB 'thresholds' table in workload account, encrypted with customer-managed key 'records' (ASM-097). PK: rule_key, SK: effective_from.
• Scope resolution: Farm-specific rule (crop#soil_moisture#farm#) overrides Pilot rule (crop#soil_moisture#pilot). NPK is pilot-wide.
• Historical immutability: Version in force at original_timestamp is evaluated, ensuring drained readings evaluate identically to live ones.
• No cache in Lambda: Strongly consistent query on every invocation; updates apply to the immediate next reading.
• Audit trail: CloudTrail data events (write-only) + DynamoDB Streams audit consumer delivering to S3 Object Lock archive (5-year retention, ASM-067).

div.div: 3. EPISODE MODEL, DEDUPLICATION & STORE-AND-FORWARD DRAIN

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 692px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1985px; margin-left: 1630px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #2d3748;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#2d3748, #b7bfce); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Why Deduplicate (Sec 6.1, ASM-135):
• Crop variables stay out of range for hours; drying grain stays hot until turned.
• Without deduplication: 1 alert every 4 hours per crop variable (or every hour in drying); 24 messages per drain.
• Prevents drone pest case explosion under ADR-002: unit of alerting is the episode, not the reading.
Episode State Machine (Sec 6.2, Alert Store, KMS 'records'):
• Open Episode: First out-of-range reading for a key with no open episode executes conditional put. Winner emits notification and persists crop_alert_raised (ADR-002 mode switch); loser attaches.
• Attach Reading: Subsequent out-of-range readings of same key update count, latest value, and extreme value. Zero notifications sent.
• Close Episode: First in-range reading with timestamp later than latest out-of-range reading closes episode (alert_resolved). Push notification sent.
• 24-Hour Reminder: If episode remains open after 24 hours, push reminder sent once per 24 hours (push only, no SMS, ASM-135).
• Drying Lot Closure: Coffee moisture <= 12% emits single drying_closure_notice per lot; marks lot ready to close (sec 6.5).
Store-and-Forward Drain Behavior (Sec 6.4, ASM-074):
• Buffer sizing: Encrypted non-volatile ring buffer holds at least 24 hours of readings (6 crop, 24 drying).
• Drainage order: On reconnection, live reading sent first, then buffered records drain oldest first.
• Delayed alert handling: Receive time > 300 s after original timestamp flagged delayed = true. Farmer sees 'measured at' and 'received at'.
• Single notification per drain: Oldest drained reading opens episode; following readings attach. 1 notification, not 24.

div.div: 4. WHAT THE FARMER SEES & ARCHITECTURAL TRACEABILITY

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 692px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1985px; margin-left: 2370px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #2d3748;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#2d3748, #b7bfce); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Multi-Channel Strategy (Closes PD-085, ASM-136):
• Dual channel: Push + SMS for alert openings and closure notices. Push only for reminders & resolutions.
• SMS: Reaches farmer over cellular connection even without data plan (LTE or later, A10 sec 11).
• Push: Enriches farmer app with full history and charts when phone enters data coverage (town/road).
• SMS Coalescing: First SMS sent immediately; further alerts for same farm within 10 min combined into 1 SMS (ASM-135).
Farmer Perception & Example Messages (Sec 8, Colombia Time America/Bogota):
• SMS, Live: 'Aroma Pacifico: farm El Mirador, soil moisture 34 % (range 40-80 %), measured 14:02. Check the app.'
• SMS, Delayed: 'Aroma Pacifico: farm El Mirador, drying grain 43 C (limit 40 C), measured yesterday 23:10, received 06:15.'
• SMS, Closure: 'Aroma Pacifico: farm El Mirador, drying lot at 12 % moisture. The lot can be closed.'
• Push, Resolution: 'Soil moisture back in range (52 %) at 18:02.'
• Messages carry farm alias only; zero farmer names, cedulas, coordinates, or clickable links.
• Farmer App (3 views): Farm Status Card (active alerts, last heard), Alerts List, History Charts (with recommended bands).
IaC & Box Traceability (Architecture sec 14, Track B):
• Box D08: Reusable Farm Module (field node, sensors, 24h buffer, X.509 cert) -> B08.
• Box D09: Telemetry Ingestion Pattern (IoT Core, topic rules, DynamoDB telemetry table, error SQS) -> B09.
• Box D10: Event-Driven Inference & Function Pattern (Threshold queue, Lambda rules engine, Alert Store, SNS) -> B10.
• Box D06: Identity & KMS Encryption Keys ('telemetry', 'records', 'personal') -> B06.
